examples.en: Boas's own research spanned the scope of anthropology in its north American definition.
examples.zh: 博厄斯自己的研究涉及了北美人类学的整个领域。

examples.en: Lukaku, a Chelsea fan, is desperate to make his mark on Andre Villas-Boas's team, but believes it will take more than one start to catch the manager's eye.
examples.zh: 作为切尔西的粉丝，卢卡库极度渴望在博阿斯的队伍里留下自己的印记，但是一场比赛的首发并不足以打动博阿斯。
